column3: Request ids gate correlation; unreadable SQL and missing batch sizes remain uncounted, with their reason reported.
Request ids gate correlation; masked or unsupported SQL, set operations and truncated statements are counted as unreadable.

sharpit SQL events do not record application frames, so annotated proxy boundaries cannot be resolved.
sharpit SQL events do not classify threads as event-loop threads; a thread name cannot prove that JDBC blocked an event loop.
